subject: general
question: Andaman and Nicobar jurisdiction comes under which High court?
solution:
Option **3** is correct:

__
 
• The Union Territory of the Andaman and Nicobar Islands__ comes under the jurisdiction of Calcutta High court.
 
• The Calcutta High court was the first high court of India and it was inaugurated in the** year 1862**.
 
• It has its jurisdiction over West Bengal and Andaman and Nicobar Islands.
